_note: English texts for everything the API sends as a key. The long clinical texts (description, physiology, protocols) are DRAFTS to be validated by the clinical team.

heart.label: Cardiovascular
heart.description: Heart and blood pressure: weightlessness redistributes fluids and puts a new load on the cardiovascular system.
heart.hardware: Bio-Monitor shirt (ECG) + oscillometric blood pressure cuff
heart.physiology: In microgravity, blood shifts toward the upper body and the heart works under a different load. Heart rate, blood pressure and heart rate variability are tracked against the pre-flight baseline.

lungs.label: Respiratory
lungs.description: Oxygenation, breathing and cabin air quality.
lungs.physiology: CO₂ builds up easily in a closed environment. The alert starts at 2.3 mmHg and 3.0 mmHg is the limit; headaches usually appear before reaching it.

brain.label: Central nervous system / Brain
brain.description: Sleep, cognitive performance and behavioral health (PHQ-9 and GAD-7 questionnaires).
brain.hardware: Actiwatch actigraph + PVT-B test + digital psychometric questionnaires
brain.physiology: Too little sleep slows reflexes (PVT-B test) and raises stress. Isolation and confinement also weigh on mood, so the questionnaires are repeated and PHQ-9 item 9 is monitored.

metabolism.label: Endocrine / Metabolism
metabolism.physiology: Stress, the flight diet and exercise change how glucose is handled. The reading is interpreted in context: fasting or after a meal.

thermal.label: Thermoregulation / Immunity
thermal.physiology: Without natural convection the body sheds heat poorly. A sustained rise in temperature can point to infection or heat fatigue, and must be judged against the activity.

radiation.label: Whole body / Radiation
radiation.description: Radiation dose received and the career budget.
radiation.physiology: Outside Earth's protection the dose accumulates. The daily rate, the percentage of the agency's career limit and solar particle events are tracked.

bones.label: Bone and muscle
bones.description: Bone density and adherence to resistive exercise.
bones.physiology: Without mechanical load, bone is lost continuously. Resistive exercise (ARED) is the main countermeasure.

eyes.label: Eyes (SANS)
eyes.description: Head and vision symptoms linked to spaceflight neuro-ocular syndrome.
eyes.hardware: Optical coherence tomography (OCT, on Earth) + crew reports
eyes.physiology: The fluid shift toward the head can alter the eye. Reports of headache or blurred vision are followed closely.

signal_cardiovascular.label: Heart and pressure sensor without signal

signal_daily_assessment.label: Sleep and reaction test without signal

protocols.green: No action required. Continue the mission routine.
protocols.yellow: Monitor the indicator and repeat the measurement as recommended.
protocols.orange: Priority attention: follow the recommendation, reduce the workload and notify the flight surgeon.
protocols.red: Emergency: apply the immediate action and contact the flight surgeon now.

ui.connectionLost: No connection to the server. Showing the last data.
